blocks.text: Bu to'rt so'z voqealarning vaqtdagi o'rnini ko'rsatadi: biror narsadan **oldin**, **keyin** yoki **paytida**. O'zbek tilida buni ko'makchilar bilan aytamiz va ular so'zdan **keyin** keladi: ish**dan oldin**, dars**dan keyin**, film **paytida**, men uxlayotgan**imda**. Ingliz tilida esa so'z oldinda turadi: **before** work, **after** the lesson, **during** the film, **while** I was sleeping. Eng muhim farq — **during** va **while**: o'zbekchada ikkalasi ham «... paytida», inglizchada esa birinchisidan keyin **ot**, ikkinchisidan keyin **gap** (ega + fe'l) keladi.

**before** — «... dan oldin», **after** — «... dan keyin». Ulardan keyin ot (**before** breakfast, **after** the match), butun gap (**before** the film starts, **after** she left) yoki fe'lning **-ing** shakli (**before** leaving) kelishi mumkin. O'zbekchada «-dan» qo'shimchasi va ko'makchi so'z birga ishlatiladi (dars**dan keyin**), inglizchada esa bitta so'z yetarli: **after** the lesson. Eslatma: hozirdan boshlab «o'n daqiqadan keyin» desak — **in** ten minutes (103-dars), **after** emas.

items.text: Let's have a cup of tea **before** the lesson.
items.translation: Dars**dan oldin** bir piyola choy ichaylik.

items.text: The children are always tired **after** school.
items.translation: Bolalar maktab**dan keyin** doim charchagan bo'ladi.

items.text: Brush your teeth **before** you go to bed.

blocks.text: **before** va **after** dan keyingi gapda kelajak haqida gapirsak ham **will** qo'yilmaydi — Present Simple yetarli: I'll call you **after** I **get** home («after I will get» emas). Bu qoida **when**, **if**, **until** uchun ham amal qiladi (98, 99, 104-darslar).

**during** dan keyin faqat **ot** keladi: **during** the lesson, **during** the summer, **during** our holiday. U «qachon?» savoliga javob beradi — voqea qaysi davr ichida bo'lganini aytadi. «Qancha vaqt?» savoliga esa **for** javob beradi (104-dars): I slept **for** two hours (qancha?) — I slept **during** the flight (qachon?). Shuning uchun «during two hours» deyilmaydi.

items.translation: Kechki ovqat **paytida** telefon ikki marta jiringladi.

blocks.text: **while** bog'lovchi: undan keyin **ega + fe'l** keladi: **while** I was cooking, **while** you're waiting, **while** the baby sleeps. Ko'pincha davomli zamon bilan ishlatiladi, chunki u bir harakat davom etib turgan paytni bildiradi (Past Continuous — 13–14-darslar). O'zbekchada bu «-ayotganda», «-ayotganimda», «-gan paytda» shakllariga to'g'ri keladi.

items.text: Somebody knocked on the door **while** I was having a shower.
items.translation: Dush qabul qilayotgan**imda** kimdir eshikni taqillatdi.

items.text: Somebody knocked on the door **during** the lesson.

blocks.text: **before** va **after** dan keyin fe'l kelsa, u **-ing** shaklida bo'ladi: **before leaving**, **after finishing**. Bu qoida barcha predloglarga tegishli (112-dars: good **at** cooking, interested **in** learning). «before to leave» yoki «after finish» — xato. Bu qolip ikkala harakatni bir kishi qilganda ishlatiladi: **After finishing** work, Aziz went home (ishni Aziz tugatdi, uyga ham Aziz ketdi). O'zbekchada: ket**ishdan oldin**, tugat**gandan keyin**.

items.text: Read the contract carefully **before signing** it.
items.translation: Shartnomani imzola**shdan oldin** diqqat bilan o'qing.

items.text: **After saying** goodbye, she got into the taxi.

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «during I was sleeping» → **while I was sleeping** (gap — while); «while the lesson» → **during the lesson** (ot — during); «during three hours» → **for three hours** (qancha vaqt — for); «before to go» → **before going**; «after finish work» → **after finishing work** yoki **after work**; «before I will leave» → **before I leave**; «After, we went home.» → **Afterwards / After that, we went home.**
Tekshirish usuli: so'zdan keyin **the / my / our / a + ot** kelsa — **during**; **I / he / we / they + fe'l** kelsa — **while**. «... paytida» deb tarjima qilsangiz, avval keyingi qismga qarang.
Bog'lanish: when bilan gaplar — 98-dars; in ten minutes — 103-dars; for, until — 104-dars; predlog + -ing — 112-dars; Past Continuous (was doing) — 13–14-darslar.

examples.title: **before** + noun: before lunch, before the exam
examples.description: **before** — «... dan oldin»: before breakfast — nonushta**dan oldin**. O'zbekchada «oldin» otdan keyin, inglizchada **before** otdan oldin turadi.

sentences.text: Wash your hands **before** dinner.
sentences.translation: Kechki ovqat**dan oldin** qo'lingizni yuving.

sentences.text: I always feel nervous **before** an exam.
sentences.translation: Imtihon**dan oldin** doim hayajonlanaman.

sentences.text: Madina usually gets up **before** six.
sentences.translation: Madina odatda soat olti**dan oldin** turadi.

sentences.text: Please be at the airport two hours **before** your flight.
sentences.translation: Iltimos, aeroportda reysingiz**dan** ikki soat **oldin** bo'ling.

sentences.text: **Before** the meeting, James printed all the documents.
sentences.translation: Yig'ilish**dan oldin** Jeyms barcha hujjatlarni chop etdi.

sentences.text: Do you drink coffee **before** work? — No, just tea.
sentences.translation: Ish**dan oldin** qahva ichasizmi? — Yo'q, faqat choy.

sentences.text: The streets were very busy just **before** Navruz.
sentences.translation: Navro'z**dan** sal **oldin** ko'chalar juda gavjum edi.

sentences.text: We need to finish this project **before** the end of the week.
sentences.translation: Bu loyihani hafta oxiri**dan oldin** tugatishimiz kerak.

sentences.text: Our guests arrived ten minutes **before** the start of the party.
sentences.translation: Mehmonlarimiz ziyofat boshlanishi**dan** o'n daqiqa **oldin** kelishdi.

sentences.text: Aziz checked the weather **before** his trip to the mountains, and it was a good idea.
sentences.translation: Aziz tog'ga sayohati**dan oldin** ob-havoni tekshirdi va bu yaxshi fikr bo'ldi.

examples.title: **after** + noun: after work, after the film
examples.description: **after** — «... dan keyin»: after school — maktab**dan keyin**. Hozirdan boshlab «o'n daqiqadan keyin» desak — **in** ten minutes (103-dars).

sentences.text: Let's go for a walk **after** lunch.
sentences.translation: Tushlik**dan keyin** sayr qilaylik.

sentences.text: **After** school Bekzod usually plays football with his friends.
sentences.translation: Maktab**dan keyin** Bekzod odatda do'stlari bilan futbol o'ynaydi.

sentences.text: I'm always very hungry **after** the gym.
sentences.translation: Sport zali**dan keyin** doim qornim juda och bo'ladi.

sentences.text: What did you do **after** the concert? — We went to a café.
sentences.translation: Konsert**dan keyin** nima qildingiz? — Kafega bordik.

sentences.text: The pavements are very slippery **after** heavy snow.
sentences.translation: Kuchli qor**dan keyin** yo'laklar juda sirpanchiq bo'ladi.

sentences.text: Sarah felt much better **after** a good night's sleep.
sentences.translation: Yaxshilab uxlagan**dan keyin** Sara o'zini ancha yaxshi his qildi.

sentences.text: My father always reads the news **after** dinner.
sentences.translation: Dadam doim kechki ovqat**dan keyin** yangiliklarni o'qiydi.

sentences.text: The shop opened again **after** the holidays.
sentences.translation: Do'kon bayram**dan keyin** yana ochildi.

sentences.text: **After** two years in London, Dilnoza speaks English very well.
sentences.translation: Londonda ikki yil yashagan**dan keyin** Dilnoza inglizchani juda yaxshi gapiradi.

sentences.text: Can we talk **after** the lesson? I've got a question about the homework.
sentences.translation: Dars**dan keyin** gaplashsak bo'ladimi? Uy vazifasi bo'yicha savolim bor.

examples.title: **during** + noun: during the film
examples.description: **during** — «... paytida / vaqtida / davomida»: during the lesson — dars **paytida**. Undan keyin faqat ot keladi; u «qachon?» savoliga javob beradi.

sentences.text: Please don't talk **during** the film.
sentences.translation: Iltimos, film **paytida** gaplashmang.

sentences.text: It snowed heavily **during** the night.
sentences.translation: Tun **davomida** kuchli qor yog'di.

sentences.text: **During** the summer holidays, Aziz worked in his uncle's shop.
sentences.translation: Yozgi ta'til **paytida** Aziz amakisining do'konida ishladi.

sentences.text: Several people fell asleep **during** the long speech.
sentences.translation: Uzun nutq **paytida** bir necha kishi uxlab qoldi.

sentences.text: Mobile phones must be switched off **during** the exam.
sentences.translation: Imtihon **vaqtida** mobil telefonlar o'chirilgan bo'lishi kerak.

sentences.text: We visited many beautiful places **during** our trip to Khiva.
sentences.translation: Xivaga safarimiz **davomida** ko'plab chiroyli joylarni ko'rdik.

sentences.text: Did anything interesting happen **during** the meeting?
sentences.translation: Yig'ilish **paytida** biror qiziq narsa bo'ldimi?

sentences.text: The museum gets very crowded **during** the tourist season.
sentences.translation: Turistik mavsum **davomida** muzey odamga to'lib ketadi.

sentences.text: Emma's phone rang twice **during** the lesson, and the teacher was angry.
sentences.translation: Dars **paytida** Emmaning telefoni ikki marta jiringladi, o'qituvchining jahli chiqdi.

sentences.text: **During** Ramadan many families have their evening meal together after sunset.
sentences.translation: Ramazon **oyida** ko'p oilalar quyosh botgandan keyin birga iftorlik qiladi.

examples.title: **while** + clause: while I was cooking
examples.description: **while** — «... ayotganda / ... gan paytda»: undan keyin ega + fe'l keladi (while I was sleeping). Ko'pincha davomli zamonlar bilan.

sentences.text: Someone phoned **while** you were out.
sentences.translation: Siz yo'q**ligingizda** kimdir qo'ng'iroq qildi.

sentences.text: I cut my finger **while** I was cooking dinner.
sentences.translation: Kechki ovqat pishirayotgan**imda** barmog'imni kesib oldim.

sentences.text: **While** we were waiting for the bus, it started to rain.
sentences.translation: Avtobus kutayotgan**imizda** yomg'ir yog'a boshladi.

sentences.text: Please be quiet **while** the baby is sleeping.
sentences.translation: Chaqaloq uxlayotgan**da** jim bo'ling, iltimos.

sentences.text: Tom listens to podcasts **while** he's driving to work.
sentences.translation: Tom ishga mashinada ketayotgan**da** podkast tinglaydi.

sentences.text: Did anyone visit **while** I was in hospital?
sentences.translation: Men kasalxonada yotgan**imda** kimdir keldimi?

sentences.text: **While** Madina was living in Manchester, she made a lot of friends.
sentences.translation: Madina Manchesterda yashagan **paytida** ko'p do'st orttirdi.

sentences.text: Can you look after my bag **while** I buy a ticket?
sentences.translation: Chipta olayotgan**imda** sumkamga qarab turasizmi?

sentences.text: My phone was stolen **while** I was sitting in a café.
sentences.translation: Kafeda o'tirgan**imda** telefonimni o'g'irlab ketishdi.

sentences.text: Bekzod did his homework **while** his little sister was watching cartoons.
sentences.translation: Singlisi multfilm ko'rayotgan**da** Bekzod uy vazifasini qildi.

examples.title: **during** + noun or **while** + clause?
examples.description: Bir xil ma'no, ikki xil qolip: **during** the meal (ot) — **while** we were eating (ega + fe'l).

sentences.text: I fell asleep **during** the film.
sentences.translation: Film **paytida** uxlab qoldim.

sentences.text: Aziz fell asleep **while** he was watching the film.
sentences.translation: Aziz film ko'rayotgan**ida** uxlab qoldi.

sentences.text: Nobody spoke **during** the meal.
sentences.translation: Ovqat **paytida** hech kim gapirmadi.

sentences.text: Nobody said a word **while** we were eating.
sentences.translation: Ovqatlanayotgan**imizda** hech kim churq etmadi.

sentences.text: There was a power cut **during** the storm.
sentences.translation: Bo'ron **paytida** elektr o'chib qoldi.

sentences.text: The lights went out **while** we were having dinner.
sentences.translation: Kechki ovqat qilayotgan**imizda** chiroqlar o'chib qoldi.

sentences.text: Did you learn any Russian **during** your stay in Moscow?
sentences.translation: Moskvada bo'lgan **paytingizda** biroz ruscha o'rgandingizmi?

sentences.text: Sarah learned a little Uzbek **while** she was working in Tashkent.
sentences.translation: Sara Toshkentda ishlagan **paytida** biroz o'zbekcha o'rgandi.

sentences.text: **During** the flight the children slept, but **while** we were waiting at the airport they were very noisy.
sentences.translation: Parvoz **paytida** bolalar uxladi, lekin aeroportda kutayotgan**imizda** juda shovqin qilishdi.

sentences.text: Never send messages **while** you're driving, not even **during** a short trip.
sentences.translation: Mashina haydayotgan**ingizda**, hatto qisqa yo'l **davomida** ham hech qachon xabar yozmang.

examples.title: **before** / **after** + **-ing**: before leaving
examples.description: Predlogdan keyin fe'l **-ing** shaklida: before **leaving**, after **finishing**. «before to leave», «after finish» deyilmaydi. O'zbekchada: ket**ishdan oldin**, tugat**gandan keyin**.

sentences.text: Always check your tickets **before leaving** home.
sentences.translation: Uydan chiq**ishdan oldin** doim chiptalaringizni tekshiring.

sentences.text: **After finishing** university, Dilnoza found a job in a bank.
sentences.translation: Universitetni tugat**gandan keyin** Dilnoza bankda ish topdi.

sentences.text: I usually read for half an hour **before going** to sleep.
sentences.translation: Odatda uxla**shdan oldin** yarim soat kitob o'qiyman.

sentences.text: James felt much better **after taking** the medicine.
sentences.translation: Dorini ich**gandan keyin** Jeyms o'zini ancha yaxshi his qildi.

sentences.text: Think carefully **before answering** the question.
sentences.translation: Savolga javob ber**ishdan oldin** yaxshilab o'ylang.

sentences.text: **After visiting** the Registan, we had lunch in a small café nearby.
sentences.translation: Registonni ziyorat qil**gandan keyin** yaqindagi kichik kafeda tushlik qildik.

sentences.text: Wash the fruit **before eating** it.
sentences.translation: Mevani ye**yishdan oldin** yuving.

sentences.text: Tom always has a shower **after playing** tennis.
sentences.translation: Tom tennis o'yna**gandan keyin** doim dush qabul qiladi.

sentences.text: **Before buying** a new laptop, Bekzod read lots of reviews online.
sentences.translation: Yangi noutbuk sotib ol**ishdan oldin** Bekzod internetda ko'plab sharhlarni o'qib chiqdi.

sentences.text: You'll feel more relaxed **after spending** a few days in the mountains.
sentences.translation: Tog'larda bir necha kun o'tkaz**gandan keyin** o'zingizni yengilroq his qilasiz.

examples.title: **before** / **after** + clause: before you go
examples.description: **before** va **after** dan keyin butun gap ham keladi: before you **go**, after we **had** dinner. Kelajak haqida bo'lsa ham — Present Simple («before you will go» emas).

sentences.text: Call me **before** you leave the office.
sentences.translation: Ofisdan chiq**ishingizdan oldin** menga qo'ng'iroq qiling.

sentences.text: **After** the last guests left, Dad and I washed all the dishes.
sentences.translation: Oxirgi mehmonlar ket**gandan keyin** dadam ikkalamiz barcha idishlarni yuvdik.

sentences.text: I'll send you the photos **after** I get home.
sentences.translation: Uyga bor**ganimdan keyin** suratlarni sizga yuboraman.

sentences.text: Please read the instructions **before** you start.
sentences.translation: Boshla**shingizdan oldin** ko'rsatmalarni o'qing, iltimos.

sentences.text: **Before** Emma moved to Oxford, she worked as a nurse in London.
sentences.translation: Oksfordga ko'ch**ishdan oldin** Emma Londonda hamshira bo'lib ishlagan.

sentences.text: We'll have dinner **after** your father comes home.
sentences.translation: Dadangiz uyga kel**gandan keyin** kechki ovqat qilamiz.

sentences.text: Make sure the oven is hot **before** you put the bread in.
sentences.translation: Nonni qo'y**ishingizdan oldin** pech qizib turganiga ishonch hosil qiling.

sentences.text: What did you do **after** you left school?
sentences.translation: Maktabni bitir**ganingizdan keyin** nima qildingiz?

sentences.text: My grandmother always washes the rice three times **before** she cooks plov.
sentences.translation: Buvim palov pishir**ishdan oldin** guruchni doim uch marta yuvadi.

sentences.text: **After** we arrived at the hotel, we realised our suitcase was still at the airport.
sentences.translation: Mehmonxonaga yetib kel**ganimizdan keyin** chamadonimiz hali aeroportda qolganini angladik.

examples.title: Mixed: a trip to London
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: **before**, **after**, **during**, **while** va **-ing** bitta sayohat hikoyasida.

sentences.text: **Before** our trip, I read a lot about London.
sentences.translation: Safarimiz**dan oldin** London haqida ko'p o'qidim.

sentences.text: My sister packed her suitcase two days **before** the flight.
sentences.translation: Opam chamadonini parvoz**dan** ikki kun **oldin** yig'di.

sentences.text: **While** we were waiting at the airport, we had breakfast.
sentences.translation: Aeroportda kutayotgan**imizda** nonushta qildik.

sentences.text: I watched two films **during** the seven-hour flight.
sentences.translation: Yetti soatlik parvoz **davomida** ikkita film ko'rdim.

sentences.text: **After** landing at Heathrow, we took the train into the city.
sentences.translation: Xitrou aeroportiga qo'n**gandan keyin** shaharga poyezdda bordik.

sentences.text: **During** our first day it rained non-stop.
sentences.translation: Birinchi kunimiz **davomida** to'xtovsiz yomg'ir yog'di.

sentences.text: Someone took my umbrella **while** I was looking at a map in a shop.
sentences.translation: Do'konda xaritaga qarayotgan**imda** kimdir soyabonimni olib ketdi.

sentences.text: We always had a big breakfast **before going** out for the day.
sentences.translation: Kun bo'yi sayrga chiq**ishdan oldin** doim to'yib nonushta qilardik.

sentences.text: **After** we saw Big Ben, we walked along the river until late evening.
sentences.translation: Big Benni ko'r**ganimizdan keyin** kech kechgacha daryo bo'yida sayr qildik.

sentences.text: **During** the flight home I was already planning our next trip.
sentences.translation: Uyga qaytish parvozi **paytida** men allaqachon keyingi safarimizni rejalashtirayotgan edim.
